title: 1980 AHSME Problem 12
statement: The equations of \(L_1\) and \(L_2\) are \(y=mx\) and \(y=nx,\) respectively. Suppose \(L_1\) makes twice as large an angle with the horizontal (measured counterclockwise from the positive \(x\)-axis) as does \(L_2,\) and that \(L_1\) has \(4\) times the slope of \(L_2.\) If \(L_1\) is not horizontal, then \(mn\) is

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: not uniquely determined by the given information

solutions.text:
Let \(\tan\theta=n.\) Then \(m=\tan(2\theta)\) and also \(m=4n.\) Hence \[ 4n=\frac{2n}{1-n^2}. \] The nonhorizontal condition gives \(n\ne0,\) so \(2(1-n^2)=1,\) or \(n^2=\frac{1}{2}.\) Thus \(mn=4n^2=2.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is C.
